description: Place a policy-checked outbound call. If you have one Line it is used; with several, pass `line`. If policy needs a human, the error carries details.approval_request (apr_…): retry with `approval` set to it once your owner approves.

approval.description: apr_… id of an approved request, when retrying

idempotency_key.description: Reuse for an identical request after a timeout; adding approval needs a new key

line.description: line_… id, when you have several

name: ordan.call.create
title: Place a call
